scenes.text: This island has one guy. Nothing else.
No house. No food. Just one palm tree.
He doesn't even have a name.
So you're going to build his whole world.
Every day, the top comments get built. With your name on them.
A house. A dog. A volcano. Anything.
But whatever you build, stays. Forever.
Day one. Name him, and tell me what he gets first.
